statement: For AHC001 rectangle packing, simulated annealing with boundary-shift moves nearly doubles the score over greedy expansion alone (81.6 vs 46.8), making SA the dominant algorithmic component.
mechanism: Greedy expansion gets stuck when neighboring rectangles block each other. SA's ability to shrink rectangles and redistribute space (via boundary shifts, expand-to-limit, and target-aware moves) enables escape from local optima.
applicability_bounds: Holds for the standard AHC001 problem constraints. May not hold if the time limit were much shorter (<2s) since SA needs sufficient iterations to converge.
